name: Blue NAP Americas
actual_location: Kaya Seru di Mahuma, Willemstad, Curaçao
reason: Declared country NL (Netherlands) does not match the real location: the facility is in Willemstad, Curaçao, as confirmed by DataCenterMap, DataCenterJournal, DataCenterDynamics and AMS-IX. Curaçao is a constituent country of the Kingdom of the Netherlands with its own ISO 3166-1 code CW; it is not part of the country Netherlands, so NL is the wrong country code (the DB uses territory codes elsewhere in this shard, e.g. GU, GP, HK, GG). The subnational field already reads 'Curacao', corroborating the mismatch.
notes: Duplicate record of the same project as rowid 22576.
